Testing a parameter combination from the sniper_real_fills_grinder output. The top keeper shows negative edge_capture (-126.0) and wide_pnl (-90.8) with a 50% win rate, suggesting it fails to capture the required J anchor edge and may be overfit to non-anchor days. ## Mechanism

Entry logic combines: volume multiplier (vol_mult=1.1), minimum candle body (body_min_cents=0.02), star rating (min_stars=2), strike offset (strike_offset=2 for ITM-2 puts), proximity to level (proximity_dollars=1.5), and require_break_above_open=true (bullish bias). Exit logic uses: premium stop (-10%), TP1 at 50% premium (selling half quantity), runner target at 200%, profit lock armed at 5% favor with 5% offset. Quantity=10 contracts implies $10K-$25K account size.
